annotations.description: Force of Negation is a premium free counterspell being used to counter a Preordain, a simple cantrip. The hand contains a Goryo's Vengeance + Atraxa combo, so exiling a blue card (likely Atraxa the combo piece, Psychic Frog the fair threat, or Meticulous Archive a needed land) is an extremely steep price to stop mere card selection.

annotations.betterLine: Let Preordain resolve. Save Force of Negation for a high-impact spell like a counterspell on your Goryo's Vengeance or a game-changing threat. Preordain is card selection, not a must-counter spell.

annotations.description: Force of Negation is being used to counter Mishra's Bauble, a 0-mana cantrip with minimal impact. The alternative cost requires exiling a blue card from hand, and the only blue cards available are Psychic Frog (key win condition) and Atraxa, Grand Unifier (the Goryo's Vengeance reanimation target - the entire combo). Exiling either of these to counter a Bauble is devastating to o3 Grudge's game plan.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Force of Negation targeting Mishra's Bauble, requiring exiling a critical blue card (Psychic Frog or Atraxa) as alternative cost
annotations.betterLine: Let Mishra's Bauble resolve - it only provides the opponent a scry-like effect and a delayed draw. Save Force of Negation for a meaningful threat or combo piece.

annotations.description: By casting Cori-Steel Cutter before Monastery Swiftspear, they missed a prowess trigger on Swiftspear. If Swiftspear had been cast first and Cori-Steel Cutter second, Swiftspear would have gotten +1/+1 from prowess (noncreature spell), while the Flurry trigger would still create the equipped Monk token. This costs 1 damage this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority on Cori-Steel Cutter (which was cast before Monastery Swiftspear), missing the prowess trigger on Swiftspear.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Monastery Swiftspear first, then cast Cori-Steel Cutter as the second spell to trigger both Swiftspear's prowess and Flurry, getting a 2/3 haste Swiftspear plus a 2/2 haste trample Monk.

annotations.description: Lethal damage was available this turn: Lava Dart to face (1), flashback Lava Dart sacrificing Mountain (1), Mutagenic Growth on Swiftspear (+2/+2 plus 3 prowess triggers on Swiftspear and Monk). Swiftspear attacks as 7/8, non-sick Monk attacks as 4/4, total 11 combat + 2 burn = 13 damage vs opponent's 12 life. Passing without casting burn/pump spells precombat risks missing this lethal line.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting any spells in precombat main.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Lava Dart targeting opponent (1 damage), flashback Lava Dart sacrificing Mountain (1 damage), then cast Mutagenic Growth on Monastery Swiftspear paying 2 life, then attack with Swiftspear and non-sick Monk for exactly lethal.

annotations.description: Gem3F Lucky cracked Arid Mesa paying 1 life unnecessarily when lethal was already available without it. With Thundering Falls untapped for Lava Dart (1 damage) and Mutagenic Growth (free via Phyrexian mana), prowess triggers give exactly 12 attack damage + 1 Lava Dart = 13, which is lethal against o3 Grudge at 12 life. The fetch wastes 1 life for no benefit.
annotations.actionTaken: Cracked Arid Mesa, paying 1 life and thinning the deck before going for the lethal attack.
annotations.betterLine: Skip the fetch. Cast Lava Dart targeting opponent (R from Thundering Falls), then cast Mutagenic Growth (pay 2 life) on Monastery Swiftspear, then attack with all creatures for exactly lethal (12 combat + 1 Lava Dart = 13 vs 12 life).

annotations.description: Gem3F Lucky has Lava Dart and Mutagenic Growth in hand with the opponent at 12 life and no blockers. Casting Lava Dart pre-combat (1 damage to face) would be the second spell this turn (after Mishra's Bauble), triggering Cori-Steel Cutter's flurry to create another Monk token attacker. Then attacking with 4 creatures and using Mutagenic Growth in combat (triggering prowess on all creatures) would likely deal lethal or near-lethal damage. Instead, they just attacked with 3 creatures without optimizing spell sequencing.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with 3 creatures without casting Lava Dart pre-combat to generate a flurry token and maximize prowess/combat damage.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Lava Dart targeting opponent (1 damage, triggers Cori-Steel Cutter flurry for a 4th attacker with prowess), then attack with all 4 creatures, cast Mutagenic Growth on Swiftspear in combat for additional prowess triggers and +2/+2, potentially dealing lethal.

annotations.description: With all of opponent's lands tapped except Watery Grave (1 mana, minimal interaction possible) and no blockers, casting Mutagenic Growth and Lava Dart during combat would trigger prowess on all three attacking creatures (+2/+2 each from two prowess triggers) plus +2/+2 from Growth on one creature plus 1 direct damage from Dart. This almost certainly represents lethal damage against the opponent at 12 life, as the attackers alone (5/5 + Swiftspear + 2/2) plus the massive prowess boosts and direct damage would far exceed 12.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to cast Lava Dart and Mutagenic Growth during combat, leaving significant damage on the table.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Mutagenic Growth (paying 2 life) targeting the biggest attacker, then cast Lava Dart targeting the opponent, triggering prowess twice on all three attacking creatures for likely lethal damage.
